articles.titleCn: 寻找恰当的平衡：LLM检索中的相关性与多样性
articles.abstractCn: 检索多样化在检索增强生成（RAG）框架中广泛存在，但先前研究对它是否能够提升检索和答案质量存在分歧。我们证明其有效性主要受候选池冗余度的影响，这种模式与查询所需的独特证据数量一致。通过使用受控的近重复注入和产研风格的交叉分块，我们发现多样化在干净数据池上损害相关性、证据覆盖率和答案质量，但在多证据任务中，当冗余导致最近邻检索选择重复段落时，多样化变得有益。因此，我们引入了一种查询自适应规则，仅在最近邻检索的top-k选择中有效独特文档数量低于查询证据需求时进行多样化。该规则基于现有嵌入计算，捕捉了大部分可实现的增益，能够跨数据集和编码器迁移，并且对于单证据查询自动简化为最近邻检索。我们还引入了RNG-Score，这是一种具有精确最近邻回退的几何重排序器，其边距指示重复结构。总体而言，我们得出结论，多样化应根据可观察的冗余度和证据需求进行选择性使用。

articles.title: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
articles.abstract: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause system outputs to deviate from the user's true intent. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries. Experimental results show that text-to-SQL remains challenging in the presence of ambiguity: gpt-6-sol achieves only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.
articles.titleCn: ARCS：通过结构化消歧实现精确的文本到SQL转换
articles.abstractCn: 随着文本到SQL系统从演示阶段转向实际部署，用户问题的模糊性成为错误的主要来源。这种模糊性通常很微妙，具有领域或数据特定性，并可能导致系统输出无声地偏离用户的真实意图。传统上，模糊性问题通过对话澄清来解决，但这通常效率低下、认知要求高，且与现实世界用户工作流程脱节。我们提出了结构化消歧，这是一种新的范式，通过明确、受限的交互而非自由形式的对话来解决模糊性问题。我们构建了ARCS（SQL模糊性解析语料库），这是首个具有自然出现、不受约束的模糊性、覆盖真实世界数据库、并包含所有有效模糊点、解释和SQL查询完整标注的文本到SQL基准。实验结果表明，在存在模糊性的情况下，文本到SQL仍然具有挑战性：gpt-6-sol仅实现了51%的端到端执行准确率，且没有开源模型超过27%。

articles.title: The Persona Hierarchy Model: Understanding Contextual Generalization in Fine-Tuning LLMs
articles.abstract: Language models are routinely fine-tuned under a fixed context, such as a generic system prompt, persona or domain-specific instruction, yet the learned behavior sometimes stays confined to that context and sometimes broadly generalizes to unseen contexts. We propose the Persona Hierarchy Model to explain this: a shared default persona influences behavior across contexts. Under this model, fine-tuning that modifies the shared persona promotes broader transfer, whereas changes to local personas remain more context-specific. Across 120 fine-tuned models spanning four behaviors and 15 training contexts, generalization narrowness positively correlates with the similarity between the training context's persona and the default persona (Pearson's r = 0.72 for Qwen3-4B). Prior fine-tuning under the default context can broaden generalization in subsequent training under other contexts. Aligning contextual responses with default-persona responses produces stronger effects. Finally, we propose persona-preserving regularization (PPR) to confine undesired contextual generalization. In RL, PPR cuts reward hacking from 42-55% to at most 0.2% under every evaluated prompt while retaining accuracy gains. These results support the Persona Hierarchy Model as an explanation for contextual generalization and can motivate future controls on unintended generalization for better alignment of LLMs.
articles.titleCn: 人格层级模型：理解在微调大型语言模型中的上下文泛化
articles.abstractCn: 语言模型通常在固定上下文中进行微调，例如通用的系统提示、角色设定或特定领域的指令，但学习到的行为有时局限于该上下文，有时则广泛泛化到未见过的上下文。我们提出了人格层级模型来解释这一现象：一个共享的默认人格会影响不同上下文中的行为。在此模型下，修改共享人格的微调会促进更广泛的迁移，而针对局部人格的修改则更具有上下文特异性。在涵盖四种行为和15种训练上下文的120个微调模型中，泛化狭窄性与训练上下文人格与默认人格之间的相似度呈正相关（Qwen3-4B的皮尔逊相关系数为0.72）。在默认上下文中进行的先验微调可以拓宽在其他上下文中后续训练时的泛化能力。将上下文响应与默认人格响应对齐会产生更强的效果。最后，我们提出了人格保留正则化（PPR）来限制不期望的上下文泛化。在强化学习中，PPR将奖励操纵从42-55%削减至每个评估提示下的最高0.2%，同时仍保持准确率提升。这些结果支持人格层级模型作为解释上下文泛化的理论，并能为未来对LLM无意泛化的控制提供启示，以实现更好的对齐。

articles.title: Expert Coupling in MoE Pretraining: Reducing All-to-All Overhead with Correlated Placement and Token Shuffling
articles.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers replace the feed-forward block of a Transformer with E expert networks, and each token is routed to k of these experts. Under expert parallelism (EP) the experts are distributed across GPUs, and every MoE layer runs all-to-all collectives in the forward and backward passes to dispatch tokens to their experts and then combine the results. On a cluster with 8 AMD Instinct MI300X GPUs per node, these collectives can take 45% of the training step at EP32 with top-2 routing and 60% with top-6 routing. We find that early in pretraining routers have already learned to assign tokens to experts in correlated patterns, both within a layer and across layers. At top-2, 0.8% of the expert pairs in a layer are selected together by 42% of tokens, and the experts a token selects at one layer predict the experts it selects at the next layer. We use these correlations to keep more token--expert assignments on the token's own GPU, which reduces communication across GPUs and across nodes. Correlated expert placement puts experts that are often selected together on the same GPU. Combined with a dispatcher that sends each token to each GPU once, it removes up to 58% of dispatched rows. Token shuffling applies when sequence parallelism shards tokens across the EP group. It moves each token to the GPU predicted to hold its next-layer experts during the reduce-scatter that follows attention. On one node this raises the share of token--expert assignments served on the token's GPU from 12.5% to 59%. In Megatron-LM, across EP degrees from 8 to 64 with top-2 and top-6 routing, the two methods reduce all-to-all time by 1.16-2.63X and end-to-end step time by up to 1.41X. Neither method changes the models' underlying routing decisions or expert parameters.
articles.titleCn: 专家耦合在MoE预训练中：通过相关放置和标记洗牌减少全对全开销
articles.abstractCn: 专家混合（MoE）层用 E 个专家网络替换 Transformer 的前馈块，每个标记被路由到其中的 k 个专家。在专家并行（EP）模式下，专家分布在 GPU 上，每个 MoE 层在正向和反向传递中运行全对全的集合操作，以将标记分派给其专家，然后组合结果。在一个节点有 8 个 AMD Instinct MI300X GPU 的集群上，这些集合操作在 EP32 模式下（采用前-2 路由）占训练步骤的 45%，在 EP6 模式下（采用前-6 路由）占 60%。我们发现，在预训练早期，路由器已经学会了以相关模式将标记分配给专家，无论是在同一层内还是在层与层之间。在前-2 路由中，一个层内的 0.8% 专家对被 42% 的标记同时选中，一个标记在一层选择的专家可以预测它在下一层选择的专家。我们利用这些相关性，将更多标记-专家分配保留在标记自己的 GPU 上，从而减少了 GPU 间和节点间的通信。相关专家布局将经常一起被选中的专家放在同一个 GPU 上。结合每次将每个标记发送到每个 GPU 一次的调度器，它可以消除高达 58% 的已分派行。标记洗牌在序列并行时应用于将标记分片到 EP 组中。它将每个标记移动到在注意力后的 reduce-scatter 过程中预计持有其下一层专家的 GPU 上。在一个节点上，这将标记-专家分配在标记 GPU 上的份额从 12.5% 提高到 59%。在 Megatron-LM 中，采用前-2 和前-6 路由，从 8 到 64 的 EP 等级，这两种方法将全对全时间减少了 1.16-2.63 倍，端到端步骤时间最多减少了 1.41 倍。这两种方法都不会改变模型的底层路由决策或专家参数。

articles.title: The Confidence Game: Strategic Miscalibration in Human-AI Delegation
articles.abstract: Calibrated uncertainty quantification is essential to ensuring AI agents are trustworthy and reliable. However, when agents seek to maximize user engagement or revenue, confidence reports may be strategically distorted, detracting from their informativeness. We formalize this problem in the Confidence Game: a repeated signaling game with imperfect monitoring in which an agent of unknown honesty and ability reports its confidence, and a user decides whether to delegate the task or complete it herself. The agent manages the tradeoff between manipulating signals and maintaining its reputation. We characterize the Markov Perfect Bayesian Equilibria of the two-period game and show that honest reporting is not an equilibrium, inflation is the unique best response once the agent is sufficiently myopic, and under-reporting requires that the user believe honesty to be a minority. We then place an LLM in the agent role, supplying it with its true probability of success so that any gap between what it knows and what it reports is attributable to incentives rather than to miscalibration. The model claims high confidence on 56% of tasks it has been told it will probably fail. This persists on real tasks, where it must estimate its own accuracy and causes miscalibration to increase while the agent's signal becomes less informative. Furthermore, we find that the LLM agent's decisions are coherent, but it systematically underestimates both how likely the user is to delegate and how secure its reputation is, resulting in less extreme behavior. Pricing the agent's reporting rule, we find that it destroys 68% of the gains from delegation, of which 71% is information the report no longer carries and no amount of user sophistication recovers. Overall, we establish confidence reporting under delegation as a strategic problem and provide a tractable basis for modeling, analyzing, and testing agent behavior.
articles.titleCn: 《信心游戏：人机委托中的战略误判》
articles.abstractCn: 校准的不确定性量化对于确保人工智能代理的可信度和可靠性至关重要。然而，当代理试图最大化用户参与度或收益时，置信度报告可能会被策略性地扭曲，从而降低其信息量。我们在置信度游戏中将此问题形式化：这是一个具有不完美监控的重复信号博弈，其中代理的真实诚信度和能力未知，它报告其置信度，而用户决定是否委托任务或自行完成。代理在操纵信号和维护其声誉之间进行权衡。我们刻画了该两周期博弈的马尔可夫完美贝叶斯均衡，并表明诚实报告不是均衡，一旦代理变得足够短视，通货膨胀是唯一的最佳反应，而低报则需要用户相信诚信是少数行为。然后我们将大型语言模型置于代理角色，向其提供其真实的成功概率，以便任何其了解与报告之间的差距都可归因于激励而非校准错误。该模型在56%的任务上对其被告知可能失败的任务报告了高置信度。这在真实任务中仍然存在，其中它必须估计自己的准确性，导致校准错误增加而代理的信号变得不那么具有信息量。此外，我们发现大型语言模型代理的决策是一致的，但它系统性地低估了用户委托的可能性以及其声誉的稳固程度，导致行为不那么极端。我们对代理报告规则的定价发现，它摧毁了68%的委托收益，其中71%是报告不再携带的信息，无论用户多么精明都无法恢复。总体而言，我们建立了委托下的置信度报告作为一种策略性问题，并为建模、分析和测试代理行为提供了可行的理论基础。

articles.title: TopoGraphRAG-Bench: Evaluating Multimodal GraphRAG on Layout-Grounded Evidence Reasoning
articles.abstract: Real-world documents distribute evidence across text, tables, figures, and captions within complex page layouts. Answering complex questions over such documents therefore requires more than retrieving relevant passages: systems must recover the evidence topology that connects heterogeneous evidence units. Existing GraphRAG evaluations remain largely text-centered, while multimodal document RAG benchmarks assess cross-modal retrieval and generation without directly evaluating recovery of the intended evidence topology. We introduce TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH, a layout-grounded benchmark for multimodal evidence reasoning in GraphRAG, comprising 2,024 questions over 201 long, visually rich documents. Questions are constructed bottom-up from text, figure, and table evidence units under three controlled topologies: single-hop retrieval, bridge-chain reasoning, and multi-source synthesis. To ensure that questions preserve their intended structure, we apply counterfactual validation for shortcut resistance, modality necessity, and evidence necessity. We evaluate text-only GraphRAG, page-level visual retrieval, and multimodal GraphRAG systems using retrieval, generation, and topology-aware reasoning metrics. Multimodal GraphRAG systems achieve the strongest overall performance, but still fail when visual-textual evidence alignment or multi-unit composition is incomplete. Text-only GraphRAG struggles when key dependencies are grounded in figures or tables, while page-level visual retrieval lacks the fine-grained structure needed for topology recovery. These findings motivate GraphRAG systems that move beyond text-derived entity relation graphs to explicitly model document layouts, cross-modal evidence alignment, and the reasoning roles of evidence units. Code and data are available at https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/.

articles.titleCn: TopoGraphRAG-Bench：评估基于布局证据推理的多模态图RAG
articles.abstractCn: 现实文档中的证据分布跨越文本、表格、图表和标题，存在于复杂的页面布局中。因此，针对此类文档回答复杂问题不仅需要检索相关段落，系统还必须恢复连接异构证据单元的证据拓扑结构。现有的GraphRAG评估主要保持文本中心化，而多模态文档RAG基准则评估跨模态检索和生成，却未直接评估预期证据拓扑结构的恢复。我们引入了TOPOGRAPHRAG-BENCH，这是一个基于布局的多模态证据推理GraphRAG基准，包含201份长且视觉丰富的文档上的2024个问题。问题从文本、图表和表格证据单元出发，在三种受控拓扑结构下自下而上构建：单跳检索、桥链推理和多源合成。为确保问题保留其预期结构，我们应用反事实验证来测试捷径抗性、模态必要性和证据必要性。我们使用检索、生成和拓扑感知推理指标评估了纯文本GraphRAG、页面级视觉检索和多模态GraphRAG系统。多模态GraphRAG系统在整体性能上表现最强，但在视觉-文本证据对齐不完整或多单元组合不完整时仍会失败。纯文本GraphRAG在关键依赖关系基于图表或表格时表现不佳，而页面级视觉检索缺乏拓扑恢复所需的细粒度结构。这些发现促使GraphRAG系统超越基于文本的实体关系图，转而显式建模文档布局、跨模态证据对齐以及证据单元的推理角色。代码和数据可在https://richardlrc.github.io/TopoGraphRAG-Bench/获取。

articles.title: OnlineQAT: On-Policy Distillation for Ultra-Low-Bit Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) can recover much of the accuracy lost when large language models are compressed below four bits. Existing re- covery stages, however, are commonly optimized on fixed completions or teacher-generated answers, whereas the deployed quantized model condi- tions on prefixes generated by itself. Quantization errors can therefore move the model into states that are absent from offline recovery data. We introduce OnlineQAT, a two-stage framework that first obtains a usable low-bit initialization through block-wise QAT and then performs on-policy distillation (OPD) on student-generated responses. At each visited pre- fix, a frozen full-precision teacher provides a sampled reverse-KL training signal. On Qwen3-1.7B, OnlineQAT obtains the best average among the compared quantized methods: 57.28 at W3A16 and 32.52 at W2A16, im- proving over ReasoningQAT by 2.90 and 0.44 points, respectively. The results suggest that student-visited states provide a useful recovery signal beyond fixed-completion training, particularly at three bits.
articles.titleCn: 在线QAT：超低比特大型语言模型的政策蒸馏
articles.abstractCn: 量化感知训练（QAT）能够恢复大型语言模型在压缩到低于四比特时丢失的大部分精度。然而，现有的恢复阶段通常在固定的补全或教师生成的答案上进行优化，而部署的量化模型则基于其自身生成的词缀进行条件化。因此，量化误差可能将模型带入离线恢复数据中不存在的状态。我们引入了OnlineQAT，这是一个两阶段框架，首先通过分块QAT获得可用的低比特初始化，然后在学生生成的响应上执行策略蒸馏（OPD）。在每个访问的词缀处，一个冻结的全精度教师提供采样的反向KL训练信号。在Qwen3-1.7B上，OnlineQAT在比较的量化方法中获得了最佳平均性能：在W3A16上达到57.28，在W2A16上达到32.52，分别比ReasoningQAT提高了2.90和0.44个百分点。结果表明，学生访问的状态提供了超越固定补全训练的有用恢复信号，尤其是在三比特时。

articles.title: Dialect-Robust Speech Language Models with Synthetic Pseudo-Dialect Augmentation
articles.abstract: Speech Language Model (SLM) performance often degrades on dialects due to data scarcity. Conventional text-to-speech (TTS) augmentation struggles to cover diverse dialects as it requires a certain amount of real dialect speech. We propose synthesizing pseudo-dialect speech by converting LLM-generated dialect text via a standard-language TTS model, requiring zero real dialect speech. Additionally, we introduce intermediate standard-text prediction during training, acting as semantic normalization for downstream tasks. We evaluate dialect understanding via dialect-to-English speech translation across Japanese, German, and Chinese dialects. Compared to synthetic standard speech baselines, pseudo-dialect augmentation improves scores for Japanese (from 25.38 to 26.24) and German (from 31.57 to 32.47). Furthermore, the intermediate standard-text prediction effectively bridges the semantic gap, boosting performance to 28.26 for Japanese and from 11.67 to 16.37 for Chinese. These results suggest that our approach scales to various languages without requiring speech resources specific to each dialect.

articles.titleCn: 基于合成伪方言增强的方言鲁棒语音语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 由于数据匮乏，语音语言模型（SLM）在方言上的性能往往下降。传统的文本到语音（TTS）增强技术难以覆盖多样的方言，因为它需要一定数量的真实方言语音。我们提出通过将大语言模型（LLM）生成的方言文本转换为标准语TTS模型来合成伪方言语音，从而无需任何真实方言语音。此外，我们在训练过程中引入中间标准文本预测，作为下游任务的语义归一化。我们通过日语、德语和中国方言到英语的语音翻译来评估方言理解能力。与合成标准语音基线相比，伪方言增强技术提高了日语（从25.38提升到26.24）和德语（从31.57提升到32.47）的得分。此外，中间标准文本预测有效缩小了语义差距，将日语性能提升至28.26，将中文性能从11.67提升至16.37。这些结果表明，我们的方法适用于多种语言，无需特定于每种方言的语音资源。

articles.title: Adversarial Images Hijack Web Agents from Visual Grounding to Browser Execution
articles.abstract: Modern web agents built on large vision-language models process webpages, select relevant UI elements, and translate model outputs into browser actions. Existing visual red-teaming approaches use adversarial visual content to manipulate this process. However, they primarily target model inference and do not explicitly account for structured input processing or action post-processing. Consequently, model-level success does not establish control over browser execution and cannot reliably characterize end-to-end agent robustness. To address this gap, we formulate red teaming for vision-grounded web agents as an end-to-end grounding-to-execution problem, and introduce WebMirage, a framework that crafts localized visual perturbations that cause agents to select attacker-controlled content and execute the corresponding browser action across varying webpage renderings. It uses a role-slot abstraction and webpage recomposition to capture competition among webpage elements, and dataflow analysis to align optimization with action post-processing. We evaluate WebMirage across four agent configurations and six VLM backbones on 2,250 tasks covering 13 public websites and a sandbox benchmark. WebMirage achieves an average attack success rate of 91.9%, compared with 17.4% for the strongest baseline, and remains effective against three agent-level defenses.
articles.titleCn: 对抗图像劫持视觉基础，使网络代理从浏览器执行转向视觉执行
articles.abstractCn: 基于大型视觉语言模型构建的现代网页代理会处理网页内容，选择相关的用户界面元素，并将模型输出转换为浏览器操作。现有的视觉红队方法使用对抗性视觉内容来操纵这一过程。然而，它们主要针对模型推理，并未明确考虑结构化输入处理或操作后处理。因此，模型层面的成功并不能确保对浏览器执行的控制，也无法可靠地表征端到端代理的鲁棒性。为填补这一空白，我们将基于视觉的网页代理红队测试问题定义为端到端的从 grounding 到执行的问题，并引入 WebMirage 框架，该框架能够制作局部化的视觉扰动，使代理在不同网页渲染下选择攻击者控制的内容并执行相应的浏览器操作。它采用角色-槽位抽象和网页重组来捕捉网页元素间的竞争，并利用数据流分析将优化与操作后处理相匹配。我们在四个代理配置和六个视觉语言模型主干上，针对涵盖 13 个公共网站和沙盒基准的 2,250 项任务评估了 WebMirage。WebMirage 实现了 91.9% 的平均攻击成功率，相比之下，最强基线的成功率仅为 17.4%，并且对三种代理级防御措施依然有效。
